summary: No critical, high, or medium security findings were identified. Report routing is centralized, group comparison is limited to admin/Sitnikov plans, delivery idempotency reduces duplicate-send risk, and admin errors are sanitized in tested failure paths.

checks.evidence: tests/test_reports_delivery.py and tests/test_reports_boundaries.py assert captain/tracker scopes and no group comparison for restricted roles.
Admin error tests assert token-like fragments and personal report body text are not included.
PDF paths use StoragePathPolicy and tests use tmp_path; reports/pdf artifacts are not generated in repo.
No new runtime dependencies were added.

residual_risk: Live Telegram adapter may introduce API-specific failure modes not covered by local fake clients.
The concrete Google Sheets adapter must preserve the same role and row-copy boundaries when implemented or wired.
